availability_price_check.name: availability_price_check
availability_price_check.value:
typeof("availability"."price") = 'text' and "availability"."price" <> ''
  and "availability"."price" not glob '*[^0-9.]*' and "availability"."price" not glob '*.*.*'
  and (instr("availability"."price", '.') = 0 or (instr("availability"."price", '.') > 1
    and length(substr("availability"."price", instr("availability"."price", '.') + 1)) between 1 and 2))
  and cast("availability"."price" as numeric) >= 0
